headline: Borisov warns of a "Greek scenario": IMF may demand cuts to pensions and salaries
summary: Former prime minister Boyko Borisov warned that rising state spending and new loans risk overheating Bulgaria's economy. He said the IMF may demand cuts to pensions and salaries, a 'Greek scenario'.
why: Bulgaria is an EU member with public debt that investors track for borrowing costs and fiscal discipline. Fiscal consolidation demands from international lenders affect bond yields and growth.
